$comment: VANISH BROKER REGISTRY — static, version-controlled reference data (PRD §16).
This is NOT user data. Adding coverage = adding a record, no code change.
VERIFICATION RULE: never enable a broker whose optOutUrl / emailTo has not been
read off that broker's own live page. A wrong opt-out address means the user's
removal request goes nowhere while they believe they are protected. That is worse
than not listing the broker at all. `verifiedAt` records when a human or an agent
last confirmed the record against the live site.
'html-parse' — Vanish's server function fetches the public search URL directly.
'assisted'   — the broker blocks automated requests (HTTP 403). Vanish does NOT
attempt to defeat that. Instead the user opens the search link in
their own browser, confirms whether they are listed, and pastes
the listing URL back. Legitimate, and it is the self-search the

brokers.name: Spokeo
brokers.note: Opt-out form needs the exact profile URL and your email; Spokeo then sends a confirmation link you must click. Each listing must be opted out separately, and Spokeo says listings can reappear as new public records arrive.

brokers.name: BeenVerified
brokers.note: Operated by The Lifetime Value Co. LLC. Their privacy policy §19.6 expressly accepts authorized-agent requests. Opt-out is a form; privacy@beenverified.com handles Right-to-Know and deletion by email.

brokers.name: Whitepages
